info.title: Gandi Public API v5
info.description: Constructed by Voxgig from Gandi's public API documentation (https://api.gandi.net/docs/), retrieved 2026-11-18T12:39:33Z. Gandi publishes no OpenAPI definition, and this is not an official Gandi document. It aims at the whole documented v5 API: 221 operations on 126 paths across the 12 documented API sections. It carries interface facts only: paths, methods, parameter and property names, types, enums, defaults, constraints, media types, status codes and the bearer scheme. Gandi's descriptions and examples are not reproduced; each operation links to the section of Gandi's documentation that describes it. The operationIds are the documentation's own anchors. The Email API is marked deprecated, as the documentation marks it.

bearerAuth.description: A Personal Access Token (`pat_...`), created in the Organization tab of the Gandi Admin application (https://admin.gandi.net/organizations/), sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The legacy `Apikey <key>` scheme is deprecated.
